products.title: Hematite Men's Bracelet
products.subtitle: Polished hematite · elastic fit
products.descriptionHtml: A single strand of polished hematite beads on a stretch elastic core. No clasp, no hardware, nothing to break. Metallic gunmetal-black, dense enough to notice the moment you pick it up.

specs.label: Stone
specs.description: Iron oxide - one of the most abundant iron ores on Earth, cut and polished for jewellery rather than industrial use.

specs.label: Hardness
specs.description: Roughly level with hardened steel - hard enough for daily wear without a special sizing chart.

specs.label: Density
specs.value: Notably dense - heavier in hand than its size suggests
specs.description: Iron content makes hematite dense - pick a piece up and it is heavier than its size suggests.

specs.label: Streak test
specs.value: Red-brown when scratched, despite the metallic black surface
specs.description: Scratch it against unglazed ceramic and it leaves red-brown, not black - the mineralogist's standard test for the real stone.

specs.label: Weight
specs.description: 70 grams on a single strand - present enough to feel deliberate, low enough to slide under a cuff.

specs.label: Core
specs.description: A stretch elastic core, not a clasp - nothing to fasten, nothing to break.

specs.label: Finish
specs.description: Hand-polished to a metallic gunmetal shine, no coating over the stone.

features.label: Natural hematite
features.body: Genuine iron oxide, not resin or dyed glass. Streak-tests red-brown under the polish.

features.label: Stretch elastic fit
features.body: One elastic core, no clasp, no sizing chart. Roll it on and forget it's there.

features.label: Free tracked shipping
features.body: Every order, every country, no threshold. Dispatched within 1-3 business days.

images.alt: Curved Hematite Ring worn on the hand

products.subtitle: Magnetic or non-magnetic · sizes 6–10
products.descriptionHtml: A curved hematite band in two finishes: natural non-magnetic hematite, or a man-made magnetic hematite (often called "hematine") for the magnetic variants. Natural hematite itself is only weakly magnetic — the strongly magnetic feel in the "Magnetic" sizes comes from that man-made version, same as most magnetic hematite jewellery on the market. We would rather tell you that than let you assume otherwise.

specs.label: Stone
specs.description: Hematite in two finishes - natural or a magnetic composite, sold and labelled as what each actually is.

specs.label: Magnetic variants
specs.description: A man-made magnetic hematite composite, often called hematine - not the weakly-magnetic natural stone.

specs.label: Non-magnetic variants
specs.description: The real, natural hematite, unmodified.

specs.label: Sizes
specs.description: Standard US ring sizing, 6 through 10.

specs.label: Finish
specs.description: Polished, curved band.

features.label: Natural or magnetic hematite
features.body: Choose natural non-magnetic hematite, or a magnetic hematite (hematine) finish - labelled honestly on every listing.

features.body: Runs true to standard US ring sizing, 6-10.
